I counted the breaths for one full minute before giving the bronchodilator and the rate was 45. I completed the bronchodilator trial. There was no chest indrawing before the bronchodilator. The child was calm during the assessment. The cough has lasted for 3 days. After the bronchodilator, I counted the breaths again for one full minute and the rate was 35. There was no chest indrawing after the bronchodilator. The child remained calm after the bronchodilator. Pulse oximeter was not available. The child does not have recurrent wheeze. The child does not have stridor when calm. The child has wheezing.
